description: This file implements a distributed mutex using etcd's concurrency package, providing locking mechanisms with tryLock, lock, unlock, and ownership checks, specifically for managing distributed locks in a Kubernetes environment.

classes.name: Mutex
classes.description: A distributed mutex implementation using etcd for coordination, supporting lock, tryLock, unlock, and ownership verification.

classes.name: lockerMutex
classes.description: A wrapper around Mutex implementing the sync.Locker interface with panic on errors.

methods.name: NewMutex
methods.description: Creates a new Mutex instance with a given session and prefix.

methods.name: TryLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock without blocking; returns immediately if lock is held by another session.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Acquires the lock, waiting if necessary, with support for context cancellation.

methods.name: tryAcquire
methods.description: Internal method to attempt to acquire the lock via an etcd transaction.

methods.name: IsOwner
methods.description: Returns a comparison object to verify ownership of the lock.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns the key associated with the lock.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Returns the response header from etcd after lock acquisition.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the mutex, panics on error.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the mutex, panics on error.

methods.name: NewLocker
methods.description: Creates a new sync.Locker backed by an etcd mutex.
